versions.content: If the function Fls_BlankCheck is configured (in the flash driver), the function Fee_Read shall call the function Fls_BlankCheck to determine in advance whether a given memory area can be read without encountering e.g. ECC errors due to trying to read erased but not programmed flash cells.
